title: Automatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Detection in Whole Slide Images Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: The tested patch-level classification accuracy was 95.33%; whole-slide detection/segmentation results were also reported.
ai_technology: A deep convolutional network classified and segmented pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma whole-slide histopathology images.
organization: Department of Automation, School of Information Science and Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai, China

evidence.tested: The tested patch-level classification accuracy was 95.33%; whole-slide detection/segmentation results were also reported.
evidence.unknown: Pathologist-confirmed 60 normal and 171 cancer samples with test evaluation; performance does not establish clinical workflow or external generalization.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
